journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: Multiplying by 10 adds a zero! 5 × 10 = 50. Multiplying by 5 gives half of × 10: 5 × 6 = 30 (half of 60).
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about multiplying by 5 and 10. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
